articles.title: Charlotte Flair surprises with a confession that could change her WWE story
articles.standfirst: The wrestler, known for her strong personality and historic career, acknowledged that there is one type of storyline she has yet to explore.
articles.summary: The wrestler, known for her strong personality and historic career, acknowledged that there is one type of storyline she has yet to explore.
articles.body:
Charlotte Flair has made it clear that she is not someone who goes unnoticed in WWE . Her strong character, personality in the ring and career filled with major accomplishments have made her one of the company’s most recognizable stars. However, despite all these years in the spotlight, there is one element that has yet to become part of her story inside the ring and, as she herself admits, it is something that sparks her curiosity.

During her appearance on The Power Hour, Charlotte Flair was asked about the possibility of one day being involved in a romantic storyline in WWE. In response, the wrestler left the door open to the idea that something like that could happen.

However, the idea did not come out of nowhere. Charlotte had already addressed the subject during her appearance at Fanatics Fest NYC .

On that occasion, she explained that she had never been involved in a romantic storyline in WWE or been paired with a male character.

A career built on major storylines

The possibility becomes even more intriguing when considering everything Charlotte has built in WWE. At 40 years old, the wrestler has won 14 world championships during her career on the main roster and has spent much of her time involved in some of the biggest rivalries in the women’s division .

Her character has also been defined by a strong personality and confidence that are essential parts of The Queen . For that reason, a romantic storyline would take her into territory she has rarely explored in front of the WWE audience.

And that is precisely what makes the idea so interesting: Charlotte is not talking about repeating a rivalry, chasing another championship or entering another major match . She is talking about showing a side of her character that has barely ever been part of the conversation.

But could it actually happen?

For now, there is no confirmed romantic storyline for Charlotte, and there is no information indicating that WWE is preparing something along those lines. Her comments simply show that she is open to the possibility if a storyline comes along that makes sense for her character.

articles.title: Dwayne Johnson slips up by revealing his return to WWE amid film-related conflicts
articles.standfirst: The Rock hints at another WrestleMania appearance despite a packed Hollywood schedule
articles.summary: The Rock hints at another WrestleMania appearance despite a packed Hollywood schedule
articles.body:
Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson may have accidentally revealed that another WrestleMania appearance is somewhere in his future.

While the Hollywood superstar didn’t provide a date or indicate whether he plans to wrestle, his recent comments strongly suggest that WWE fans haven’t seen the last of him at its biggest annual event.

Johnson made a surprise appearance on The Morning Shift while the hosts were discussing “Your Dad,” a song associated with his upcoming Moana project.

The conversation eventually moved toward his legendary WWE career when one of the hosts admitted that seeing The Rock make his famous WrestleMania entrance in person remained on his bucket list.

The response from Johnson was enough to get wrestling fans talking.

Johnson made a promise that he’d be invited whenever The Rock eventually returns to WrestleMania. His choice of words was particularly interesting because he didn't say “if” he goes back. Instead, he spoke about it as something that would happen at some point.

“I’ll make the promise to you now, whenever I do go back to WrestleMania, I gotta have you guys out,” Johnson said, promising that the hosts would be his special guests.

The comment comes after a lengthy absence from WWE television. Johnson's most recent appearance was at Elimination Chamber 2025, where he played a pivotal role in John Cena's shocking heel turn and further established his “Final Boss” persona.

His last match, meanwhile, took place at WrestleMania 40. The Rock teamed with Roman Reigns against Cody Rhodes and Seth Rollins in one of the event's most heavily discussed encounters.

Hollywood commitments could complicate The Rock’s WWE return

Although Johnson's comments have sparked speculation, they don't confirm that he’ll appear at WrestleMania 43. The 2027 event is scheduled to take place in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, marking the first time WrestleMania will be held outside North America.

One major obstacle could be Johnson's increasingly busy Hollywood schedule. He’s expected to return as Luke Hobbs in Fast Forever, the planned final mainline installment of the Fast & Furious franchise.

Production is expected to begin in December 2026, with the movie currently scheduled for release in March 2028.

That could create a significant scheduling challenge if WWE hopes to bring Johnson back for a match. An in-ring comeback, particularly one involving a major WrestleMania storyline, would require substantial physical preparation and training.

Johnson had previously appeared to be part of the direction surrounding Cody Rhodes and John Cena , but he ultimately didn't participate in their WrestleMania 41 championship showdown.

There’s no confirmed opponent, storyline or date for The Rock's next WWE appearance. Still, his promise suggests that another WrestleMania entrance could eventually become reality.

The only question is whether his movie commitments will determine when fans finally see The Final Boss step through the ropes again.
